تكاثرت (form VI)
# تَكَاثَرْتُ (takāṯartu) /ta.kaː.θar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَاثَرَ (takāṯara)
# تَكَاثَرْتَ (takāṯarta) /ta.kaː.θar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَاثَرَ (takāṯara)
# تَكَاثَرْتِ (takāṯarti) /ta.kaː.θar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَاثَرَ (takāṯara)
# تَكَاثَرَتْ (takāṯarat) /ta.kaː.θa.rat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
